name: go-containerregistry-resource-bounded-image-30fd
instr:
go-containerregistry cannot apply cumulative manifest-byte, config-byte, layer-count, and compressed-byte bounds across an image operation. Implement one evaluation that follows validation, comparison, archive creation, and publication without resetting, while preserving the observable semantics of daemon, mutation, schema1, and partial images and accounting for actual work.

Make the first cancellation or limit breach the stable terminal result of an `Evaluation`. Later image and reader operations must return it without increasing usage. `Evaluation.Report` must deterministically expose limits, usage, completion, and the terminal error. `LimitError` identifies the exhausted `EvaluationResource`; `EvaluationError` retains operation context. `EvaluateImage` must use `BoundedImage.Evaluate` when available and otherwise provide consistent bounded behavior, including through `NewEvaluableImage`.

Cover all metadata, layers, and content examined or exposed while preserving established lazy, buffered, artifact, duplicate-layer, ordering, and unsupported-operation behavior. `validate.WithEvaluationLimits(limits)`, `tarball.WithEvaluationLimits(limits)`, `remote.WithEvaluationLimits(limits)`, and `crane.WithEvaluationLimits(limits)` must carry one allowance through complete operations. `compare.ImagesWithEvaluation(ctx, a, aLimits, b, bLimits)` evaluates operands independently, returns both reports, preserves legacy schema1 layer order, and stops consuming the peer after terminal fai
